name: MercyOne Des Moines Teen Volunteers (Ages 16 to 17)
what_you_do: Volunteer at MercyOne in a role that fits your skills. The program page does not list the teen roles.
who_can_apply: Teens at least 16 years old. You must be in school in good standing or working toward a GED. A parent or guardian must agree.
duration: At least 4 months. The weekly hours are not stated for teens.
deadline_text: No deadline posted on the program page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Teen Volunteer application online. Then expect a criminal background check. Expect a registered offender check and a health screening too. You also need proof of immunizations, references and an interview. Contact Anne Owens at anne.owens@mercyone.org. Or call 515-358-9265.
notes: Are you 14 or 15? Look at the teen program at UnityPoint Iowa Lutheran Hospital.
